checkpoint: model.pth selected by the existing TRAIN-internal calibration-nll policy after completion of all 100 event epochs and required 25 pretraining epochs; selected_epoch must agree in checkpoint and run.json and lie in 1..100; no forced final-epoch substitution
completion: Pinned run.json plus pinned history epoch sequence 1..100; inspect no calibration metric values; no DEV metrics
scope: Only original TRAIN fit waveforms and magnitude labels are used; full-file hashes and identity-only split/sidecar checks include bytes or identities of other partitions without decoding their waveforms or consulting their labels/metrics
selection_and_gate: All original protocol population rules and strict event-level gate thresholds remain unchanged
point_prediction: Reuse source evaluation float64 casts of native float32 mixture weights for mean/median; density and output derivatives use normalized log-softmax logits in float64; report both weights and their rounding discrepancy
not_authorized: No execution on real data until parent supplies completed pinned artifacts and authorizes launch; no training head or follow-up training is implemented
